G0800.def:
ἀ-σύμφωνος, -ον 
[in LXX: Wis.18:10, Da, LXX, Bel 1:15 * ;] 
dissonant, discordant; metaphorically, at variance: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Actes 28:25.†

G0801.def:
ἀ-σύνετος, -ον
[in LXX: Deutéronome 32:21 (נָבָל). Job 13:2 (נָפַל), Psaumes 92:6 (כְּסִיל), Psaumes 76:5, Wis.2:1-24, Sir.6:1-37 * ;] 
without understanding or discernment: Matthieu 15:16, Marc 7:18 (Swete, in l), Romains 1:21, 31 10:19 (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, see MM, see word).†

G0802.def:
ἀ-σύν-θετος, -ον
(συντίθεμαι ν. M, Pr., 222; MM, see word), [in LXX: Jérémie 3:7-11 (בָּגַד)* ;] 
false to engagements, not keeping covenant, faithless (MM, see word): Romains 1:31.†

G0803.def:
ἀσφάλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for בָּטַח, etc. ;] 
__1. firmness. 
__2. certainty: Luc 1:4. 
__3. security: Actes 5:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:3. 
(In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, Th., l.with)†

G0804.def:
ἀσφαλής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pu., etc. ;] 
certain, secure, safe: Actes 21:34 22:30 25:26, Philippiens 3:1, Hébreux 6:19 (MM, see word).†

G0805.def:
ἀσφαλίζω
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX: Néhémie 3:15 (חָזַק hi.), Ésaïe 41:10 (תָּמַךְ), Wis.4:17 10:12 13:15 * ;] 
to make firm, secure: mid., Matthieu 27:65-66, Actes 16:24; pass., Matthieu 27:64 (MM, see word).†

G0806.def:
ἀσφαλῶς 
adv., [in LXX: Genèse 34:25 (בֶּטַח), Tob.6:4, Wis.18:6, Bar.5:7, 1Ma.6:40, 3Ma.7:6 * ;] 
__(a) safely: Marc 14:44, Actes 16:23; 
__(b) assuredly: Actes 2:36.†

G0807.def:
ἀσχημονέω, -ῶ
(ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: Eze.16:7, 22 16:39 23:29 (עֶרְיָה); Deutéronome 25:3 (קָלָה ni.)* ;] 
to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably: 1 Corinthiens 13:5; before ἐπί, ib. 1 Corinthiens 7:36 (MM, see word).†

G0808.def:
ἀσχημοσύνη, -ης, ή
(ἀσχήμων), [in LXX chiefly for עֶרְוָה ;] 
unseemliness: Romains 1:27 (MM, see word); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as frequently in LXX, shame, nakedness: Apocalypse 16:15.†

G0809.def:
ἀσχήμων, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σχῆμα) [in LXX: Genèse 34:7 (נְבָלָה), Deutéronome 24:1 (עֶרְוָה), Wis.2:20, Da TH Sus 1:63, 2Ma.9:2 * ;] 
__1. shapeless. 
__2. uncomely, unseemly: 1 Corinthiens 12:23.†

G0810.def:
ἀσωτία, -ας, ή
(ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: Proverbes 28:7 (זָלַל), 2Ma.6:4 * ;] 
prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy: Éphésiens 5:18, Tite 1:6, 1 Pierre 4:4 (MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v

G0811.def:
ἀσώτως 
adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, Proverbes 7:11 * ;] 
wastefully: Luc 15:13 
(EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).†

G0812.def:
ἀτακτέω -ῶ
(ἄτακτος), 
primarily, of soldiers marching, to be out of order, to quit the ranks; hence, metaphorically, to be remiss, fail in the performance of duty (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): 2 Thessaloniciens 3:7 (on ἀ. and its cognates, see M, Th., 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).†

G0813.def:
ἀ-τακτος, -ον
(τάσσω), [in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 * ;] 
out of order, out of place (Lat. inordinatus), frequently of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. 3Ma.1:19); hence, metaphorically, irregular, disorderly (see previous word): 1 Thessaloniciens 5:14.†

G0814.def:
ἀ-τάκτως 
adv., [in Sm.: 4Ki.9:20 * ;] 
disorderly, irregularly: 2 Thessaloniciens 3:6 3:11.†

G0815.def:
ἄτεκνος, -ον
(τέκνον), [in LXX: Genèse 15:2, Lévitique 20:20-21 (עֲרִירִי), Ésaïe 49:21, Jérémie 18:21 (שָׁכֹל), Sir.16:3 * ;] 
childless: Luc 20:28-29.†

G0816.def:
ἀτενίζω
(ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), [in LXX: I Esther 6:28, 3Ma.2:26 * ;] 
to look fixedly, gaze (MM, see word): with dative of person(s), gaze upon: Luc 4:20 22:56, Actes 3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Actes 3:4 6:15 13:9; metaphorically, Actes 1:10 7:55 11:6, 2 Corinthiens 3:7 3:13.†

G0817.def:
ἄτερ 
prep., [in LXX: 2Ma.12:15 * ;] 
in cl. most frequently in poets; without, apart from: with genitive, Luc 22:6, 35 (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).†

G0818.def:
ἀτιμάζω
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX for בּוּז, קָלָה, etc. ;] 
to dishonour, insult: Marc 12:4, TTr., mg., WH, Luc 20:11, Jean 8:49, Romains 2:23, Jacques 2:6; pass.: Actes 5:41, Romains 1:24 (cf ἀτιμάω).†

G0819.def:
ἀτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄτιμος) [in LXX for כְּלִמָּה, קָלוֹן, etc. ;] 
dishonour, disgrace: 1 Corinthiens 11:14, 2 Corinthiens 6:8; εἰς ἀ., Romains 9:21, 2 Timothée 2:20; ἐν ἀ., 1 Corinthiens 15:43; κατ᾽ ἀ., 2 Corinthiens 11:21; πάθη ἀτιμίας, base passions, Romains 1:26.†

G0820.def:
ἄτιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX: Ésaïe 3:5 (קָלָה ni.), Ésaïe 53:3 (בָּזָה), Job 30:4, 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5:1-23, Sir.1:1-30 * ;] 
without honour, dishonoured, despised: Matthieu 13:57, Marc 6:4, 1 Corinthiens 4:10; comp., 1 Corinthiens 12:23.†

G0822.def:
ἀτμίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
[in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;] 
vapour: Jacques 4:14; ἀ. καπνοῦ, Actes 2:19 (LXX).†

G0823.def:
ἄ-τομος, -ον
(τέμνω), [in Sm.: Ésaïe 54:8 (MM, see word) * ;] 
indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., 1 Corinthiens 15:52.†

G0824.def:
ἄ-τοπος, -ον
(τόπος), [in LXX: Job 4:8 11:11, Proverbes 30:20, al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 
__1. out of place, not befitting. 
__2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): Actes 28:6; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense, 
__3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): Luc 23:41, Actes 25:5, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:2.†

G0825.def:
Ἀτταλία (Rec. -άλεια), -υς, ἡ 
Attalia, a city of Pamphylia: Actes 14:25.†

G0826.def:
αὐγάζω
(αὐγή), [in LXX: Lévitique 13:24-28, 38 14:56 (בֹּהֶרֶת) Lévitique 13:39 (כֵּהֶה)* ;] 
__1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate. 
__2. Intrans. 
__(a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word) 
__(b) as in LXX, to shine forth: 2 Corinthiens 4:4 (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†

G0827.def:
αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 59:9 (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12:9 * ;] 
__1. brightness 
__2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: Actes 20:11 (Cremer, 118).†
SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi).

G0828.def:
Αὔγουστος, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: Luc 2:1 (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).†

G0829.def:
αὐθάδης, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: Genèse 49:3, 7 (עַז), Proverbes 21:24 (יָהִיר)* ;] 
self-pleasing, arrogant: Tite 1:7, 2 Pierre 2:10 (Cremer, 654).†
SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii)

G0830.def:
αὐθαίρετος, -ον
(αὐτός, αἱρέομαι), [in Sm.: Exode 35:5, 22 * ;] 
__1. self-chosen. 
__2. of one's own accord: 2 Corinthiens 8:3 8:17.†

G0831.def:
αὐθεντέω, -ῶ
(αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wis.12:6; cf. -ία, 3Ma.2:29; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word) 
to govern, exercise authority over: 1 Timothée 2:12.†

G0832.def:
αὐλέω, -ῶ
(αὐλός), [in Al.: 3Ki.1:40 * ;] 
to play on a flute, to pipe: mid., Matthieu 11:17, Luc 7:32, 1 Corinthiens 14:7.†

G0833.def:
αὐλή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for חָצֵר ;] 
__1. in Hom., an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold: Jean 10:1, 16 
__2. the court, courtyard, round which a house is built: Matthieu 26:3, 58 26:69, Marc 14:54, 66 15:16 Luc 11:21 22:55, Jean 18:15; τ. ναοῦ, Apocalypse 11:2. a dwelling, a palace (so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): Matthieu 26:3, 58, Marc 14:54 15:16, Luc 11:21, Jean 18:15 (but see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).†

G0834.def:
αὐλητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(αὐλέω), 
a flute-player: Matthieu 9:23, Apocalypse 18:22 (MM, see word).†

G0835.def:
αὐλίζομαι
(αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;] 
__1. prop., to lodge in a courtyard. 
__2. to lodge in the open. 
__3. to pass the night, lodge (LXX; MM, see word): Matthieu 21:17, Luc 21:37.†

G0836.def:
αὐλός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for חָלִיל ;] 
a pipe: 1 Corinthiens 14:7.†

G0837.def:
αὐξάνω
(and the earlier form αὔξω, Éphésiens 2:21, Colossiens 2:19; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה ;] 
__1. trans., to make to grow: 1 Corinthiens 3:6-7, 2 Corinthiens 9:10. Pass., to grow, increase, become greater: Matthieu 13:32, Marc 4:8, 2 Corinthiens 10:15, Colossiens 1:6; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, Colossiens 1:10; εἰς σωτηρίαν, 1 Pierre 2:2. 
__2. In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., to grow, increase: of plants, Matthieu 6:28, Luc 12:27 13:19; of infants, Luc 1:80 2:40; of a multitude, Actes 7:17; of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, Actes 6:7 12:24 19:20; of Christ as a leader, Jean 3:30; of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, Éphésiens 4:15; εἰς ναόν, Éphésiens 2:21; ἐν χάριτι, 2 Pierre 3:18; τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, Colossiens 2:19 (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).†

G0838.def:
αὔξησις, -εως, ἡ
(αὔξω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:16 * ;] 
increase, growth: Éphésiens 4:16, Colossiens 2:19.†

G0839.def:
αὔριον 
adv., [in LXX for מָחָר ;] 
to-morrow: Matthieu 6:30, Luc 12:28, Actes 23:20 25:22, 1 Corinthiens 15:32, Luc 13:32-33, Jacques 4:13; ἡ αὔ. (sc. ἡμέρα, MM, see word), Matthieu 6:34, Actes 4:3; ἐπὶ τὴν αὔ., Luc 10:35, Actes 4:5; τὸ (WH om.) τῆς Jacques 4:14.†

G0840.def:
αὐστηρός, -ά, -όν
(αἄω, to dry up) [in LXX: 2Ma.14:30 * ;] 
prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, strict, severe (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): Luc 19:21-22.†
SYN.: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv)

G0841.def:
αὐτάρκεια, -ας, ἡ
(αὐτάρκης, which see), 
__(a) sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), 2 Corinthiens 9:8; 
__(b) contentment: 1 Timothée 6:6.†

G0842.def:
αὐτάρκης, -ες
(αὐτός, ἀρκέω), [in LXX: Proverbes 30:8 (חֹק), Sir.5:1 11:24 31:28 40:18, 4Ma.9:9 * ;] 
as in cl., in philosophical sense, self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented: Philippiens 4:11 (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).†

G0843.def:
αὐτο-κατά-κριτος, -ον
(αὐτός, κατακρίνω), 
self-condemned: Tite 3:11 (Eccl., Cremer, 377; MM, see word).†

G0844.def:
αὐτόματος -ον, and -η, -ον 
(etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word), [in LXX, Lévitique 25:5, 11, 4Ki.19:29 (סָפִיחַ), Josué 6:5, Job 24:24, Wis.17:6 * ;] 
__1. of persons, acting of one's own will. 
__2. Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord: γῆ Marc 4:28 (MM, see word); πύλη, Actes 12:10.†

G0846.def:
αὐτός, -ή, -ό, 
determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399). 
__1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii); 
__(1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, Luc 5:37; αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, Jean 2:25; αὐ.ὑμεῖς, Jean 3:28; καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, Romains 15:14; αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, Jean 2:24; αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, Marc 2:25; ὑμεῖς αὐ., Marc 6:31; esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, Matthieu 3:4, Marc 6:17, Jean 16:27, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:11, al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, in that hour, Luc 10:21 (M, Pr., 91; MM, see word); 
__(2) emphatic, he, she, it (M, Pr., 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), Matthieu 1:21, 12:50, Luc 6:35, al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), Matthieu 8:24, Marc 4:38, al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), Matthieu 14:2, Marc 14:15, 44, Luc 1:22, 2:28, al.
__2. In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), he, she, it, Matthieu 7:9, 10:12, 26:44, al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., Matthieu 9:18, Marc 13:1, al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), Marc 7:25, Apocalypse 3:8, 7:2, al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, Matthieu 4:23, Actes 8:5, 2 Corinthiens 2:13, al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, Romains 11:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:19, Tite 3:5, Hébreux 2:4.
__3. ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., the same: Hébreux 1:12, 13:8; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, Matthieu 5:46, 47, al.; φρονεῖν, Romains 12:16, 15:5, Philippiens 2:2, al.; τὰ αὐ., Actes 15:27, Romains 2:1, al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), Actes 14:1, Luc 6:23, al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., together (MM, see word), Matthieu 22:34, Actes 1:15, al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., 1 Corinthiens 11:5, 12:11; with dative (cl.), 1 Corinthiens 11:5; with a noun, λόγος, Marc 14:39; μέτρος, Philippiens 1:30; πνεῦμα, 1 Corinthiens 12:4.

G0847.def:
αὐτοῦ 
adv., prop. neut. genitive of αὐτός, [in LXX for פֹּה, בָּזֶה ;] 
there: Matthieu 26:36, Marc 6:33, WH, mg., Luc 9:27, Actes 15:34, WH, mg., R, mg., Actes 18:19 21:4 .†

G0849.def:
αὐτό-χειρ, -ρος, ὁ, ἡ
(αὐτός, χείρ), 
with one's own hand: Actes 27:19.†

G0850.def:
αὐχμηρός, -ά, -όν
(αὐχμός, drought); 
__1. dry 
__2. squalid, dismal: 2 Pierre 1:19 (MM, see word).†

G0851.def:
ἀφ-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX (Cremer, 615 f.) for סוּר, עָבַר, H7311 כָּרַת, etc. (35 words in all) ;] 
to take from, take away, take off: with accusative, τὸ ὠτίον, Matthieu 26:51, Marc 14:47 (ὠτάριον, WH), Luc 22:50 (οὖς); ὄνειδος, Luc 1:25; before ἀπό, Apocalypse 22:19, Luc 16:3 (mid.); pass., C. genitive, Luc 10:42; ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, Hébreux 10:4, Romains 11:27 (mid.) (MM, see word).†

G0852.def:
ἀφανής, -ές
(φαίνω), [in LXX: Néhémie 4:8(2), Job 24:20, Sir.20:30 41:14, 2Ma.3:34 * ;] 
unseen, hidden: Hébreux 4:13.†

G0853.def:
ἀφανίζω 
(ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.). 
__2. Later (MM, see word) 
__(a) to destroy: Matthieu 6:19-20; 
__(b) to disfigure: Matthieu 6:16. Pass., to vanish: Jacques 4:14; to perish: Actes 13:41(LXX).†

G0854.def:
ἀφανισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה ;] 
vanishing: Hébreux 8:13.†

G0855.def:
ἄφαντος, -ον
(φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word) 
invisible, hidden: Luc 24:31.†

G0856.def:
ἀφεδρών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(cf. ἄφεδρος, Lévitique 12:5) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word), 
a privy, drain: Matthieu 15:17, Marc 7:19 (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).†
**ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ 
(ὀχέω, to carry) [in Sm.: Job 22:24, Psaumes 65:10 al. ;] 
__1. a water-pipe, channel. 
__2. the intestinal canal: Marc 7:19, WH, mg. (for ἀφεδρών).†

G0857.def:
ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀφειδής, unsparing); 
__1. extravagance. 
__2. unsparing treatment, severity: Colossiens 2:23.†

G0858.def:
ἀφελότης, -ητος, ἡ
= cl. ἀφέλεια (see MM, see word), 
simplicity: Actes 2:46†

G0859.def:
ἄφεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀφίημι), [in LXX for יוֹבֵל, דְּרוֹר, etc. (see Deiss., BS, 98 ff.; MM, see word) ;] 
__1. dismissal, release: Luc 4:18. 
__2. Metaphorical, of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, Matthieu 26:28, Marc 1:4, Luc 1:77 3:3 24:47, Actes 2:38 5:31 10:43 13:38 26:18, Colossiens 1:14; παραπτωμάτων, Éphésiens 1:7; absol., Marc 3:29, Hébreux 9:22 10:18 (cf. DB, ii, 56; DCG, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).†
SYN.: πάρεσις, which see (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii)

G0860.def:
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;] 
a joint (MM, see word): Éphésiens 4:16, Colossiens 2:19 (Lft., in l).†

G0861.def:
ἀφθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: Wis.2:23 6:19, 4Ma.9:22 4Mac 17:12 * ;] 
incorruptibility, immortality: Romains 2:7, 1 Corinthiens 15:42 15:50 15:53-54, 2 Timothée 1:10; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., Éphésiens 6:24 (see AR, in l).†
ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ 
(φθείρω), [in LXX: Aggée 2:17 (שְׁדֵפָה)* ;] 
uncorruptness: Tite 2:7 (Rec. ἀφθορία).†

G0863G.def:
ἀφ-ίημι, 
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1 Corinthiens 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Genèse 35:18, Hdt., al.), Matthieu 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Marc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Matthieu 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Matthieu 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Matthieu 9:2, Romains 4:7" (LXX), 1 Jean 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Marc 2:5, Luc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Luc 5:23. 
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Matthieu 4:11 5:24 15:14, Marc 1:20, 31 Jean 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Marc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hébreux 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Apocalypse 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Matthieu 13:36 22:22, Marc 8:13, al. 
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Matthieu 3:15; with accusative, Matthieu 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:40; with inf. pres., Matthieu 23:14, al.; aor., Marc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Marc 11:16, Jean 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Matthieu 7:4 27:49, Marc 15:36, Luc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).

G0863H.def:
ἀφ-ίημι, 
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1 Corinthiens 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Genèse 35:18, Hdt., al.), Matthieu 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Marc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Matthieu 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Matthieu 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Matthieu 9:2, Romains 4:7" (LXX), 1 Jean 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Marc 2:5, Luc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Luc 5:23. 
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Matthieu 4:11 5:24 15:14, Marc 1:20, 31 Jean 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Marc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hébreux 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Apocalypse 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Matthieu 13:36 22:22, Marc 8:13, al. 
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Matthieu 3:15; with accusative, Matthieu 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:40; with inf. pres., Matthieu 23:14, al.; aor., Marc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Marc 11:16, Jean 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Matthieu 7:4 27:49, Marc 15:36, Luc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).

G0863I.def:
ἀφ-ίημι, 
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 
__1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), 1 Corinthiens 7:11-13; of death, τ. πνεῦμα (Genèse 35:18, Hdt., al.), Matthieu 27:50; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, Marc 15:37; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, Matthieu 18:27; τ. ὀφειλήν, Matthieu 18:32; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, Matthieu 9:2, Romains 4:7" (LXX), 1 Jean 1:9, al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Marc 2:5, Luc 11:4; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), Luc 5:23. 
__2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: Matthieu 4:11 5:24 15:14, Marc 1:20, 31 Jean 4:3, 28 al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, Marc 7:8; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, Hébreux 6:1; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, Apocalypse 2:4; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), Matthieu 13:36 22:22, Marc 8:13, al. 
__3. to let, suffer, permit: Matthieu 3:15; with accusative, Matthieu 3:15, 19:14, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:40; with inf. pres., Matthieu 23:14, al.; aor., Marc 5:37, al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, Marc 11:16, Jean 12:7; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), Matthieu 7:4 27:49, Marc 15:36, Luc 6:42 (see further MM, see word).

G0864.def:
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι 
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;] 
perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), Romains 16:19.†

G0865.def:
ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον 
without love of good: 2 Timothée 3:3 (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†

G0866.def:
ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον 
without love of money, not avaricious; 1 Timothée 3:3, Hébreux 13:5. (For other instances, see MM, see word)†

G0867.def:
ἄφ-ιξις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: 3Ma.7:18 * ;] 
in cl. usually, arrival; rarely, departure: Actes 20:29 (so in π., cf. MM, see word; M, Proverbes 26:1-28, n.).†

G0868.def:
ἀφ-ίστημι 
[in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;] 
__1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, to move to revolt: Actes 5:37. 
__2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: with genitive, Luc 2:37; before ἀπό, Luc 4:13 13:27, Actes 5:38 12:10 15:38 19:9 22:29, 2 Corinthiens 12:8; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, 2 Timothée 2:19; ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), Hébreux 3:12 Mid. (exc. 1 aor., WH. is trans.), to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from: Luc 2:37; metaphorically, fall away, apostatize: absol., Luc 8:13; with genitive, 1 Timothée 4:1 (MM, see word; Cremer, 308).†

G0869.def:
ἄφνω 
adv., [in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם ;] 
suddenly: Actes 2:2 16:26 28:6.†

G0870.def:
ἀφόβως 
adv. (φόβος), [in LXX: Proverbes 1:33 (פַּחַד), Wis.17:4 * ;] 
without fear: Luc 1:74, Philippiens 1:14, 1 Corinthiens 16:10, Ju 12.†

G0871.def:
ἀφ-ομοιόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Wis.13:14, Ep. Jer 1:5, 63, 71* ;] 
to make like: pass., Hébreux 7:3.†

G0872.def:
ἀφ-οράω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:10 (είς θεόν)* ;] 
__(a) to look away from all else at, fix one's gaze upon: metaphorically (MM, see word), Hébreux 12:2; 
__(b) simply, to see: ἀφίδω (see: ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phi., in l; MM, see word), Philippiens 2:23 (see Ellic., in l).†

G0873.def:
ἀφ-ορίζω 
[in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בָּדַל hi., סָגַר hi., נוּף hi., רוּם hi etc. ;] 
__(a) to mark off by boundaries from, separate from: with accusative, Actes 19:9, Galates 2:12; id. before ἐκ (ἀπό), Matthieu 13:49 25:32 (MM, see word); of excom­munication, Luc 6:22. Pass., absol., 2 Corinthiens 6:17; 
__(b) to set apart, devote to a special purpose (before εἰς): with accusative, Galates 1:15. Mid., Actes 13:2, Romains 1:1 (DB, iii 588).†

G0874.def:
ἀφ-ορμή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Eze.5:7 (הָמוֹן), Proverbes 9:9, 3Ma.3:2 * ;] 
prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaphorically, an occasion, incentive, opportunity (MM, see word): 2 Corinthiens 11:12, Galates 5:13; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, Luc 11:24, WH, mg., Romains 7:8, 11; ἀφ. διδόναι, 2 Corinthiens 5:12, 1 Timothée 5:14.*

G0875.def:
ἀφρίζω
(ἀφρός), 
to foam at the mouth: Marc 9:18, 20.†

G0876.def: foam , of the sea, (Iliad by Homer): of an angry lion, foam, froth , (Iliad by Homer); ἀπ᾽ ἀνθρώπων ἀφρόν frothy blood , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

G0877.def:
ἀφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ἄφρων), [in LXX for אִוֶּלֶת, נְבָלָה, etc. ;] 
foolishness: Marc 7:22, 2 Corinthiens 11:1 11:17 11:21.†

G0878.def:
ἄφρων, -ον genitive -ονος 
(φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc. ;] 
without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" (Hort; cf. MM, see word): Luc 11:40 12:20, Romains 2:20, 1 Corinthiens 15:36, 2 Corinthiens 11:16 12:6 12:11, 1 Pierre 2:15; opposite to φρόνιμος, 2 Corinthiens 11:19; to συνιέντες, Éphésiens 2:17.†

G0879.def:
ἀφ-υπιόω, -ῶ
(ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: Genèse 28:11 * ;] 
__1. to awake from sleep (Anth.). 
__2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), to fall asleep: Luc 8:23.†

G0880.def:
ἀφωνος, -ον
(φωνή) [in LXX: Ésaïe 53:7 (עָלַם ni.), Wis.4:19, 2Ma.3:29 * ;] 
dumb, speechless: Actes 8:32 (LXX); of idols (MM, see word), 1 Corinthiens 12:2; of beasts, 2 Pierre 2:19; τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, unintelligible: 1 Corinthiens 14:10.†

G0881.def:
Ἄχαζ (WH, Ἄχας), ὁ (Heb. אָחָז), 
Ahaz: Matthieu 1:9.†

G0882.def:
Ἀχαία (T, Ἀχαΐα), -ας, ἡ (Bl., § 46, 11) 
Achaia, the Roman province: Actes 18:12, 27 19:21 Romains 15:26, 1 Corinthiens 16:15, 2 Corinthiens 1:1 9:2 11:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:7-8.†

G0884.def:
ἀχάριστος, -ον
(χαρίζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.16:29, Sir.29:17, 25, 4Ma.9:10 * ;] 
__(a) ungracious, unpleasing; 
__(b) ungrateful, thankless: Luc 6:35, 2 Timothée 3:2.†

G0886.def:
ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος, -ον
(χειροποίητος) 
not made by hands: Marc 14:58, 2 Corinthiens 5:1; metaphorically, περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual ), Colossiens 2:11 (MM, see word).†

G0887.def:
ἀχλύς, -ύος, ἡ 
[in Aq.: Eze.12:7; Sm.: Job 3:5 * ;] 
a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: Actes 13:11 (see Tr., Syn., § with).†

G0888.def:
ἀ-χρεῖος, -ον
(χρεῖος, useful), [in LXX: 2 Rois 6:22 (שָׁפָל), Ep. Jérémie 17:1-27 * ;] 
useless, unprofitable: Matthieu 25:30, Luc 17:10 (MM, see word).†

G0889.def:
ἀχρεόω (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ 
(ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος) [in LXX (-ειόω) for אָלַח ni., etc. ;] 
to make useless, unprofitable: pass., Romains 3:12 (LXX).†

G0890.def:
ά-χρηατος, -ον 
[in LXX: Osée 8:8 (חֵפֶץ אַיִן), Wis.2:11, Sir.16:1, al. ;] 
useless; unserviceable: opposite to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.†

G0892.def:
ἄχυρον, -ον, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן ;] 
chaff: Matthieu 3:12, Luc 3:17.†

G0893.def:
ἀ-ψευδής, -ές
(ψεῦδος), [in LXX: Wis.7:17 * ;] 
free from false-hood, truthful: Tite 1:2.†

G0894.def:
ἄψινθος, -ου, ἡ
(also ἀψίνθιον, τό; ἀψινθία, ἡ), 
wormwood: as a proper name, Apocalypse 8:11.†

G0895.def:
ἄψυχος, -ον
(ψυχή), [in LXX: Wis.13:17 14:29 * ;] 
inanimate, lifeless: 1 Corinthiens 14:7.†

G0896.def:
Βάαλ (Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord), 
Baal: Romains 11:4 (LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (בֹּשֶׁת for בַּעַל), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ (cf. 3Ki.18:19), and to account for the frequently use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however, is not general, and in the passage cited in Ro (3Ki.19:18), LXX reads τῷ Β. †

G0897.def:
Βαβυλών, -ῶνος, ἡ (בָּבֶל, Heb. form of Assyr. Bab-ili, Gate of God), 
Babylon: Matthieu 1:11, 12 17, Actes 7:43" (LXX) ; symbolically, of Rome: Apocalypse 14:8 16:19 17:5 18:2, 10, 21, and prob. also 1 Pierre 5:13.†

G0898.def:
βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ, Ion. form of βασμός 
(βαίνω, to step), [in LXX 1 Rois 5:5 (מִפְתָּן), 4Ki.20:9, 10 11 (מַעֲלָה), Sir.6:36 * ;] 
a step (4Ki, l.with, of degrees of a dial); metaphorically, a degree, standing: 1 Timothée 3:13.†

G0899.def:
βάθος, -εος (-ους), τό, 
[in LXX for מְצוּלָה ,תַּחְתִּי, etc. ;] 
depth: Matthieu 13:5, Marc 4:5, Romains 8:39, Éphésiens 3:18; τὸ β., the deep sea: Luc 5:4; metaphorically, β. πλούτου . . . Θεοῦ, Romains 11:33; τὰ β. τ. Θεοῦ (the Divine counsels), 1 Corinthiens 2:10; ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία, deep poverty, 2 Corinthiens 8:2.†
